verdict.rationale: Llama models can be downloaded and run via CLI tools (llama-model download/list/verify) and llama.cpp, which supports headless/scriptable use in CI or automation pipelines, and function-calling/agent-optimized inference is documented. However, there is no first-party CI/automation guide, no official headless server mode or Docker/CI recipe, and docs pages are gated behind SSO login limiting public verifiability. missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless-server documentation, official Docker/CI integration examples, independent hands-on confirmation of automated pipeline use.
